questions: Should the function raise a ValueError for empty inputs (size zero) or treat them as valid (e.g., resulting in empty DataFrame)?
What should be the dtype of the output DataFrame (float, int, etc.)?
Should the function accept numpy arrays only, or also other array-like inputs (lists, pandas Series)?
Is the matrix-tensor multiplication order defined as P @ T (where T's first dimension matches P's columns) or T @ P?
Should the normalization be applied with ddof=0 (population std) or ddof=1 (sample std) as in StandardScaler default?
What should happen if the resulting array after multiplication has only one column (n=1)? Should normalization still be applied?
Should the function ensure the output DataFrame index is default (RangeIndex) or preserve some indexing from inputs?
Is the flattening of the result done in row-major (C) or column-major (F) order?
